herdr_path.label: Herdr binary
herdr_path.description: Path to the herdr executable. ~ is expanded. A bare name works too — the panel puts ~/.local/bin back on PATH, which Noctalia does not inherit from niri.

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.description: Terminal used to host the session, invoked as <terminal> --class=… --title=… -e herdr …. Those flags are ghostty's, so another terminal may need panel.luau adjusted.

app_id.label: Window app-id
app_id.description: app-id given to the terminal window. The niri config maximizes anything under local.maximized.*, so the default opens the session full-width without a herdr-specific window rule.
